services.name: Introduction to Tides and Currents
services.desc: Our Introduction to Tides and Currents course guides students through the concepts behind tidal exchanges and currents, including how to integrate tide and current predictions into small boat trip planning. By the end of the course, students should be able to plot a simple afternoon or multi-day trip. This course is great for boaters of all types and skill-levels. Cost: We ask for a minimum donation of $20. Introduction to Tides and Currents Outline: Session 1 0-10 min Introduction, Housekeeping 10-70 min PowerPoint – Tides and Currents in the San Juan Islands 70-85 min Introduce Resources Two 90-minute virtual sessions • Great for boaters of all types and skill-levels!

services.name: Private Kayaking Lessons
services.desc: Learn to kayak! First Student (all ages welcome) - $60 per hour Each Additional Students (all ages welcome) - $40 per hour About The Community Boating Center offers private kayaking lessons for all ages during the operating season (April through October). Enjoy a customized lesson to fit your needs. Private lessons are a great way to enhance your kayaking skills and enjoy one-on-one instruction. Our private lessons are tailored to your comfort, experience level, and desired learning objectives. Lessons can include kayaking fundamentals, technique, and performance skills, wet exits and Starting at $60 per hour • All ages welcome
